title: Asymmetric Correspondence Learning for Lexical and Style Embeddings: Interpreting Latent Space via Acoustic Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.09313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-supervised speech embeddings jointly encode lexical, speaker, and prosodic information, complicating feature isolation. We introduce Asymmetric Correspondence Learning (ACL), distilling HuBERT features into separate Acoustic Word Embeddings (AWEs) and Acoustic Style Embeddings (ASEs) via a split-latent correspondence bottleneck. Through probing and clustering evaluations on single-word utterances, we demonstrate that substantial variance from extrinsic sources remains encoded within each latent space, despite linear probing indicating the information has been stripped. Whilst the AWE space exhibits cohesive lexical clustering (AP$\approx$0.90, Fisher$\approx$6.28), linear probing on the ASE space achieves 97.9\% speaker accuracy across a diffuse topology (Fisher$\approx$1.01), yet preserves substantial lexical variance (Fisher$\approx$0.86) that remains linearly unrecoverable (0.17\%). translated_title: 面向词汇与风格嵌入的非对称对应学习：通过声学特征解读潜在空间
translated_abstract: 自监督语音嵌入同时编码了词汇、说话人和韵律信息，这使得特征分离变得困难。我们提出了非对称对应学习（ACL），通过分割潜在空间的对应瓶颈，将HuBERT特征蒸馏为相互独立的声学词嵌入（AWEs）和声学风格嵌入（ASEs）。通过对单词语句的探测与聚类评估，我们证明：尽管线性探测表明相关信息已被剥离，但来自外部来源的大量方差仍然保留编码在每个潜在空间之中。AWE空间呈现出紧密的词汇聚类（AP≈0.90，Fisher≈6.28）；而ASE空间在扩散的拓扑结构上通过线性探测达到了97.9%的说话人识别准确率（Fisher≈1.01），同时保留了大量线性不可恢复的词汇方差（Fisher≈0.86，线性可恢复仅0.17%）。为了解释这些发现，我们应用了组级别的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出非对称对应学习（ACL）方法，通过分割潜在对应瓶颈将HuBERT特征蒸馏为相互独立的声学词嵌入与声学风格嵌入，并揭示了即使在探测显示信息已被剥离的情况下，各潜在空间中仍隐含保留着来自外部来源的大量方差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Asymmetric Correspondence Learning (ACL), which distills HuBERT features into separate acoustic word and style embeddings via a split-latent correspondence bottleneck, and reveals that substantial extrinsic variance remains implicitly encoded in each latent space even when linear probing suggests the information has been stripped.
